agency-agents.note: Submodule removed — no agent from these packs was ever spawned. Nothing vendored.

awesome-codex-subagents.note: Submodule removed — 17 agents vendored into codex-agents/packs/ (data-ai 13, llmops 4) under MIT attribution.

oh-my-codex.license_source: package.json (no LICENSE file at repo root)

my-claude.note: Claude Code counterpart of this repo — same Boss orchestration in native Claude .md agent format. Linked from the README as a sister project only; install.sh never clones, curls, or copies anything from it, so nothing is vendored here and there is no pin to track.

codeburn.note: Local-first AI token/cost tracker; parses ~/.codex/sessions read-only, no proxy, no upload. No hooks on Codex (read-only).

archify.note: Diagram skill (architecture/workflow/sequence/dataflow/lifecycle -> standalone HTML with inline SVG). Only the repo's top-level archify/ directory is installed, as ~/.codex/skills/archify. Tag-pinned, so update-upstream.yml skips it in --remote.

serena.note: Symbol-level code navigation/editing MCP server. Installed with `uv tool install --python 3.13`; registered as [mcp_servers.serena] in ~/.codex/config.toml (stdio, startup_timeout_sec = 15). Installed as a standalone tool, never vendored or linked into this repo.
serena.license_note: The distributed serena-agent package is GPL-3.0-or-later as a whole: it combines the GPL-3.0-or-later Serena application with MIT-licensed SolidLSP, and the repo LICENSE states the combination is subject to GPL-3.0-or-later. The SolidLSP files remain MIT when taken on their own. PyPI metadata declares MIT (license field and classifier) and is inaccurate -- do not change this entry back to MIT on its authority. Installed as a standalone uv tool and used over MCP; nothing vendored or linked into this repo.

headroom.note: Context compression MCP server (headroom_compress / headroom_retrieve / headroom_stats). Installed with `uv tool install --python 3.13 "headroom-ai[all]==0.37.0"`; registered as [mcp_servers.headroom] (stdio, `headroom mcp serve`). The `headroom wrap` proxy mode works on a subscription login but is deliberately not automated: Codex cannot reach the API while the proxy is down, so it stays a documented manual opt-in.

ast-grep.note: Structural code search/rewrite CLI used by agents
